products.name: 버터 미니 버킷백
products.design: Fictional concept sample. Small cylindrical bucket handbag, flat circular base, open top with one simple leather drawstring, one short curved handle attached at opposite sides by two brass rings, plain cream lining, no pockets. No logos or lettering. Preserve shape and all hardware counts.

shotDirections.front: Standing front three-quarter with handle upright and drawstring loosely closed.
shotDirections.back: Rear view with handle and circular base visible.
shotDirections.texture: Macro leather grain and handle attachment brass ring.
shotDirections.model-front: Adult woman ivory blouse, cropped torso carrying bag by short handle at hip, no face.
shotDirections.model-side: Same clothing and bag carried in hand from side, entire handle visible.
shotDirections.model-back: Top-down open bag showing cream lining and empty single compartment.
shotDirections.editorial: Bag standing on pale stone bench in daylight.
